obligation: Broker ownership and custody authority is explicit and single-owner.
Broker lifecycle progression is deterministic across accepted, rejected, pending, filled, cancellation, timeout, retry, recovery, and terminal states.
Broker interfaces preserve authority, normalize requests and responses, reject unsupported inputs, and handle acknowledgement uncertainty.
Broker evidence is immutable, execution-derived, non-synthetic, and preserves raw and normalized truth.
Broker reconciliation and anomaly handling preserve contradictions, late events, duplicate events, and unresolved uncertainty without overwriting history.
Broker certification is independently reproducible from canonical proof, traceability, evidence, and verifier execution.
